demo.title: “Is the paneer bowl available for pickup tonight?”
demo.copy: A customer question arrives in the restaurant’s own WhatsApp context. The assistant can help interpret it; it does not invent inventory or promise an order.
demo.detail: Invented scene; no real customer or menu data is used.

demo.title: A reviewed menu gives the conversation useful context.
demo.copy: A future controlled setup could provide a validated catalog or menu. This preview uses an invented item and no restaurant data.
demo.detail: Invented scene; suggestion ≠ published menu state.

demo.title: Pickup order drafted for business review.
demo.copy: The proposed order is structured so staff can accept, reject or correct it. Payment and order state are not inferred from a chat message.
demo.detail: Invented scene; status: needs human review.

demo.title: A person can take over when context needs care.
demo.copy: Human takeover is part of the intended pilot boundary. Staff remain responsible for controlled business decisions and customer communication.
demo.detail: Invented scene; no message is sent from this page.
